pr.title: gh-111178: fix UBSan failures in `Modules/xx*.c`
pr.body:
This PR fixes the UBSan failures and addresses some minor cosmetic changes. PEP-7 changes were not applied since they could scramble the diff but other semantic changes affecting the signature of touched functions may have been done.

<!-- gh-issue-number: gh-111178 -->
* Issue: gh-111178
<!-- /gh-issue-number -->

issue_comments.body: Ah I'm sorry I put this one as ready for review but I learned that _ + capital letter was also UB (https://github.com/python/cpython/pull/128248#issuecomment-2615838172) so I'll fix them tomorrow.
